context: Hina and Sho enjoy fall fruit together.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: しょう、秋の果物、本当、美味しい。
lines.en: Sho, autumn fruit is really delicious!
lines.style: Bright, eager opening. Genuine childish delight—no performance. Leans forward slightly. Warm and inclusive, inviting him into the discovery. Voice light, unpretentious.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Yeah, persimmons especially. Really like them.
lines.style: Soft, quiet agreement. A small genuine smile underneath. No rushing. The warmth of being included in something nice. Gentle, observant tone—not flashy.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: 一緒に、本当、食べる、楽しい。
lines.en: Eating them together is really fun.
lines.style: Tender and direct. The pleasure of the simple moment landing in her voice. Slight warm pause before the closing. Unpretentious—just stating something true. Real childish sweetness.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Quiet, understated. A small six-year-old's genuine contentment. No big feelings—just the quiet warmth of being with someone he likes. Soft landing on the final word.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Warm closing affirmation. Her voice circles back to him gently. Slight trailing warmth—the moment settling between them. Childish sincerity without performance.
